links.outcome: LLM diagnosis, differential diagnosis, examination and treatment quality scored by experts on real cases
links.effect: Med-Go median 37.5 (IQR 31.9-41.5), Gemini 33.0 (IQR 25.5-36.6), p<0.001; differential diagnosis weakest, treatment strongest; inaccuracies could lead to adverse decisions.
links.quote: Analysis revealed that responses related to differential diagnosis were the weakest, while those pertaining to treatment recommendations were the strongest.

screen.reason: Evaluates the clinical accuracy of three LLMs (ChatGPT-4, Gemini, Med-Go) on 134 actual clinical cases retrospectively evaluated by experts without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
